trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: This study analyses what wages fell.
trap.right: This study analyses how wages fell.
trap.why: Em textos acadêmicos, o brasileiro confunde what e how em análises. Também it is clear that wages have fallen: método e resultado.

opts: This study is analysing of wage data.
It is clear that wages have fallen.
It is clear what wages have fallen.

fix.right: It is clear that prices rose.

rewrite.prompt: Escreva o resultado: “Wages have fallen, clearly.” (It is clear…)
rewrite.answer: It is clear that wages have fallen.
